name: sort-versions
prompt: The release picker shows 1.9.0 as newer than 1.10.0. Fix src/versions.js: sortVersions must order versions numerically part by part (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, an optional leading "v" is kept in the output), a pre-release such as 2.0.0-rc.1 comes before 2.0.0, and pre-release identifiers compare dot-part by dot-part (numerically when both parts are numbers, so beta.2 < beta.10). latest() returns the newest final release, and the newest pre-release only when there is no final release at all.
